blockingIssues.description: validate_plugin_actions trims action.id before validation and duplicate checks, so whitespace-padded IDs pass validation while runtime registration/dispatch matches exact untrimmed IDs. This can make manifest actions discoverable but non-deterministically fail to bind dispatch handlers.
